sections.heading: Ponda Taluka's Estates: Kundaim, Usgao, Bethora and Madkai
paragraphs: Ponda taluka has four industrial estates close together: Kundaim, Usgao, Bethora and Madkai. A list of operational projects approved by the Goa Investment Promotion Board, tabled in the Goa Legislative Assembly as an annexure to an unstarred question, shows what they make. Ponda entries in it include tablets, capsules and injectables at Kundaim, bulk drug and soft-gel capsules at Usgao, beer at Bethora, Indian-made spirits at Madkai, and a chocolate section at a food plant in Usgao.

Kundaim is also named in Herald Goa reporting as one of the four places where Goa's pharmaceutical manufacturing is concentrated, alongside Verna, Pilerne and Colvale. The same reporting notes how much of Goa's pharma output comes from contract manufacturers rather than brand-owning plants.

sections.heading: Injectables at Kundaim: Where WFI and Clean Steam Come In
paragraphs: The Goa-IPB list records an approved expansion at Zydus Lifesciences, plots 203 to 213 in the Kundaim estate, adding capacity of 196 million tablets, 20 million capsules and 20 million injections. The last of those changes the piping brief. An oral-solid block can run on a purified-water loop; an injectable block also needs water for injection and pure steam, and those systems are almost always built in 316L with an electropolished bore.

For a Kundaim plant adding a parenteral line next to oral solids, it is worth keeping the two scopes separate on the drawing. The WFI loop, clean-steam distribution and the transfer lines to the filling room take SF4 tube; the oral-solid purified-water loop can often stay at SF1.

sections.heading: Bulk Drug and Soft-Gel Capsules at Usgao, Ponda
paragraphs: Two approvals on the list concern one site at survey number 11/1, Marvasodo, Usgao: Procter & Gamble Health (formerly Merck) raising bulk-drug capacity from 636.4 to 1,080 tonnes a year, and doubling its soft-gel unit from one to two billion capsules. Bulk-drug synthesis and soft-gel encapsulation ask different things of stainless tube.

In API synthesis, the reactors and solvent lines are judged on grade and weld quality; the finish matters at final isolation and in the purified-water loop that feeds washes. Soft-gel lines move warm gelatin and oily fill mixtures that cling to a rough bore, so transfer lines and the CIP that cleans them are where an electropolished 316L surface shortens changeovers.

sections.heading: Brewing at Bethora and Spirits at Madkai
paragraphs: The list shows United Breweries expanding at Bethora from 0.75 million to one million cases a month, and Mandovi Distilleries & Breweries at plot D-8, Madkai, from 7 lakh to 12 lakh cases a year of brandy, whisky, rum, vodka and gin. On the food side, Nestlé India's entry for plots 294 to 297 in the Usgao estate mentions a hand-wash area at the entry to its chocolate section.

In a brewery, wort, yeast and bright-beer lines are cleaned with hot caustic and acid many times a week, and a smooth, drainable bore cuts the risk of beer-spoilage organisms surviving between brews. Grade 304 covers most brewery and blending duty; 316L is the safer choice where acid cleaning is heavy or chlorides are present.

sections.heading: Which Ponda Lines Need SF1 and Which Need SF4
bullets: Oral-solid purified-water loop at ambient temperature: SF1 316L.
WFI, pure steam and parenteral transfer lines at Kundaim: SF4 electropolished 316L throughout.
Soft-gel transfer and the CIP serving it: SF4 to shorten changeovers between fills.
Bulk-drug solvent and recovery lines: correct grade and sound welds first; polished bore optional.
Brewery wort, yeast and bright-beer lines: 304 or 316L, SF1 in most cases, with drainable slopes.

sections.heading: Delivery to Kundaim, Usgao, Bethora and Madkai
paragraphs: Ponda is reached by road from Mumbai down the coast, and Mormugao Port is the nearest sea gateway for export-bound material. Dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation.

sections.heading: What a Ponda Plant Should Put in Its Enquiry
paragraphs: Send one line list with the service on each line (purified water, WFI, pure steam, CIP supply or return, soft-gel fill, wort or beer), design temperature, sanitisation method, OD and wall per size, total length and whether ends are for orbital welding or clamps. Contract manufacturers should mark which lines fall inside each client's audit scope, so the finish can be matched line by line.

Send it through our contact page for a quotation within 30 minutes. Each lot carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number, a PMI record for every length and, for electropolished tube, an internal Ra report for the qualification file.
